Childhood program requires that all practicum students who plan to conduct their practicum at the SIPI Early

the background check process as soon as he/she enters the program. Students who wish to complete practicums
off campus, must complete a CYFD background check. Students must provide proof of a favorable background
clearance to be enrolled in all practicum courses. Students should work with advisors to complete a practicum
application one semester before placement.
